camera_site_survey.marketingCopy: Security camera placement is a skill - put cameras in the wrong places and you get blind spots, glare, poor coverage, and gaps right where incidents happen. The Camera Site Survey is a walkthrough and placement recommendation service that determines exactly where cameras should go before you buy anything. We walk your property, identify the areas that need coverage, evaluate lighting, sight lines, and entry points, and recommend specific camera types and positions. You get a professional placement plan that covers what matters - so you don't spend money on cameras that miss the action.
bestFor: Businesses planning a camera system who want professional placement guidance
Organizations that want to avoid blind spots and wasted camera purchases
Property owners adding coverage to entry points, lots, or storage areas
Businesses that want a documented camera plan before purchasing equipment
whatIsIncluded: Entry point and sight line evaluation
Specific camera type and placement recommendations
customerOutcomes: A professional camera placement plan before you spend on equipment
Coverage designed around your actual property and risks
No expensive blind spots from poor placement
A documented plan you can purchase against

single_camera_add_on.marketingCopy: Adding one camera to an existing system should be simple - but integrating it correctly, pointing it at the right area, and getting it recording properly takes more than plugging it in. The Single Camera Add-On adds one camera to an appropriate existing camera system: installation, configuration, network setup, and integration with your recording. We mount the camera in the right spot, configure it to join your system, verify recording and viewing work, and document the addition. One more camera, properly installed and fully functional, extending your coverage where you need it.

Organizations that want one more camera at a specific location

small_camera_system_setup.marketingCopy: A small 2-4 camera system is the right size for many businesses - but only if it's set up properly with recording, storage, and viewing that actually work. The Small Camera System Setup handles the complete setup of a small camera system: installation, configuration, recording setup, storage management, and basic viewing access. We place and install the cameras, configure the recording, set up storage with sensible retention, and make sure you can view footage. Your business gets a working 2-4 camera system with reliable recording - not cameras that sit unconfigured or fail to record when it matters.

camera_health_check.marketingCopy: Camera systems fail silently - a camera stops recording, a blind spot develops, storage fills up, or an account becomes stale - and most businesses never notice until they need footage and find nothing there. The Camera Health Check reviews your camera system's health: recording status, blind spots, storage, account access, and camera condition. We verify cameras are actually recording, identify coverage gaps, check storage capacity and retention, review who has access, and assess camera health. You get a clear picture of your camera system's reliability before you need footage it didn't capture.
bestFor: Businesses that rely on cameras but haven't verified they're recording
Organizations concerned about blind spots or storage issues
Companies unsure who has access to their camera system
Businesses that want camera reliability verified proactively
whatIsIncluded: Recording status verification for all cameras
customerOutcomes: Verification that your cameras are actually recording
Blind spots and storage issues identified before they matter
A clear picture of who has camera access
A documented camera system health assessment

nvr_cleanup.marketingCopy: The NVR is the brain of your camera system - and over time, recording schedules get sloppy, channels get misnamed, permissions grow stale, and storage fills up. The NVR Cleanup cleans up and configures your recording system properly: recording schedules, channels, naming, permissions, and storage settings. We straighten out what's recording when, fix channel naming so footage is findable, review permissions, and manage storage settings and retention. Your NVR becomes a system you can actually rely on to find footage when you need it - instead of a mess you avoid until an incident.

Permissions and storage managed properly

The Remote Camera Access Setup configures secure remote viewing for owners and managers. We set up remote access to your camera system, configure it securely so footage isn't exposed to the internet unprotected, and verify viewing works from phones and computers. You get the ability to check your business from anywhere - with remote access that's secure, not an open door into your system.

The Camera Maintenance Plan is a recurring service that keeps your camera system healthy: lens cleaning, firmware updates, recording and storage verification, and access review. Each cycle your cameras get checked, cleaned, updated, and verified, with issues caught early. It's proactive maintenance that keeps your camera system recording reliably - instead of discovering failures only when you need the footage.
